title: Undergraduate Program
text:
S. No. | Subjects
01. | B.Sc. Agriculture (Hons) Eligibility: F.Sc. or equivalent. At least 2nd division (45% marks). Scheme of Studies (https://awkum.edu.pk/faculties-colleges/faculty-of-chemical-life-sciences/agriculture/programs/)
02. | Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Eligibility: F.Sc./FA or equivalent. At least 2nd division (45% marks). Scheme of Studies (https://awkum.edu.pk/faculties-colleges/faculty-of-business-economics/ibl/ibl-programs/)
03. | Bachelor of Computer Science (BCS-Hons) Eligibility: F.Sc. (Pre-Engineering), FCS (Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics). At least 2nd division (45% marks). Scheme of Studies (https://awkum.edu.pk/faculties-colleges/faculty-of-physical-numerical-sciences/cs-garden/programs/)
04. | Bachelor of Computer Science (BCS-Software) Eligibility: F.Sc. (Pre-Engineering), FCS (Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics). At least 2nd division (45% marks). Scheme of Studies (https://awkum.edu.pk/faculties-colleges/faculty-of-physical-numerical-sciences/cs-garden/programs/)
05. | Bachelor of Design (B. Des.) Eligibility: Intermediate or equivalent. At least 2nd division (45% marks). Scheme of Studies (https://awkum.edu.pk/faculties-colleges/faculty-of-arts-humanities/pca-2/pca-programs/)

35. | Pharm-D (5 Years Degree Program) Eligibility: F.Sc. (Pre-Medical) or equivalent with at least 60% marks in aggregate.
